name: CL1138.2-1133 outskirts (Hubble)
blurb: An outskirts field of the galaxy cluster CL1138.2-1133, seen by Hubble.
label: cl11381-hubble
story: Hubble looked into the outskirts of this distant galaxy cluster, where galaxies are still falling in, hoping to catch spiral galaxies on their way to becoming lenticulars.

claims.text: CL1138.2-1133 is a galaxy cluster in the ESO Distant Cluster Survey (EDisCS)
CL1138-1 is a Hubble pointing of program 13393, which imaged positions in the outskirts of intermediate-redshift galaxy clusters
Program 13393 studies galaxy transformation in the infall regions of clusters
The program seeks what transforms spiral galaxies into lenticular (S0) galaxies
